{{redirect|S12|the Japanese TCG release with the set symbol S12|Silver Tempest (TCG)}} {{Season Infobox |background=AAF |cellcolor=FCC |name=Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles |image=Galactic Battles Logo.png |caption=Logo for the season |number=12 |opening=Battle Cry - (Stand Up!) |numeps=52 |region=[[Sinnoh]] |series=''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'' |prev=Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension |next=Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors }} '''Pokémon: DP Galactic Battles''' is the twelfth [[season]] of the [[dub]]bed version of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It is the third season of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]''. It follows {{Ash}} and {{an|Dawn}} as they continue their travels throughout the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]], gathering [[Gym]] [[Badge]]s and {{pkmn|Contest}} [[Ribbon]]s while accompanied by {{an|Brock}}. Unlike previous seasons in the dub, there was no break between this season and the previous one. It originally aired in {{pmin|the United States}} as part of the 2009-2010 Cartoon Network Saturday morning lineup. It began on May 9, 2009 with the dub premiere ''[[DP105|Get Your Rotom Running!]]'', and concluded on May 15, 2010 with ''[[DP157|Gotta Get a Gible!]]''. This season skipped [[DP120]] due to it being a [[clip show]]. It is preceded by [[S11|Pokémon: DP Battle Dimension]] and succeeded by [[S13|Pokémon: DP Sinnoh League Victors]]. ==Blurb== ''As the menace of Team Galactic continues to loom over the Sinnoh region, Ash and Dawn keep getting caught up in the schemes of this mysterious group of villains—as well as facing some other unexpected challenges! Dawn’s got her hands full dealing with the many problems of her Pokémon, while Ash’s ongoing rivalry with Paul finally comes to a head in a full 6-on-6 battle! It might be the ultimate test of training styles—will our heroes come out on top?'' ==Important events== {{spoilers}} [[File:OP12 English logo V1.png|thumb|250px|Title card used in the first 15 episodes of the season.]] [[File:OP12 English logo V2.png|thumb|250px|Title card used after the first 15 episodes of the season.]] * {{Ash}} meets [[Roark]] again. ([[DP107]]) * Responding to a call by {{an|Barry}}, Ash and {{ashfr}} head for [[Iron Island]] and meet [[Riley]] and his Lucario. They discover [[Mars]], along with some {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s, are attacking the Iron Island to make a scan of [[Mt. Coronet]] in search of the [[Spear Pillar]]. [[Professor Carolina]] reappears to study the island. ([[DP110]]-[[DP111]]) * {{an|Dawn}} wins her fourth [[Ribbon]] in the {{to|Chocovine}} {{pkmn|Contest}}, after battling her newest [[rival]], [[Ursula]]. ([[DP114]]) * Ash enters the [[Squallville PokéRinger]] and defeats [[Paul]] in the finals. ([[DP118]]) * After caring for her injured {{TP|Dawn|Mamoswine}}, Dawn manages to earn Mamoswine's obedience. ([[DP119]]) * {{an|Brandon|Pyramid King Brandon}} arrives in [[Snowpoint City]] to visit the nearby [[Snowpoint Temple|temple]]. ([[DP128]]) * Paul challenges Brandon after hearing Ash defeated him. Brandon defeats all of Paul's team without losing a single Pokémon. [[Reggie]] suggests a battle between Paul and Ash in a couple days time. * [[J|Pokémon Hunter J]] attacks the Snowpoint Temple and awakens the {{p|Regigigas}} there. In the aftermath, Regigigas is resealed and Brandon leaves his {{TP|Brandon|legendary giants}} behind to protect it. ([[DP129]]) * While heading to [[Lake Acuity]] by train, Ash and his friends meet [[Looker]], not knowing he is an investigator going after [[Team Galactic]]. ([[DP130]]) * Ash and Paul have their first [[Full Battle]] at Lake Acuity. ([[DP131]]-[[DP132]]) * Ash and his friends come upon [[Saturn]] and [[Charon]] searching for the Spear Pillar. They meet Looker again and learn he is with the [[International Police]]. ([[DP136]]) * Ash and his friends head for [[Twinleaf Town]] for the [[Twinleaf Festival]]. ([[DP138]]) * Ash, Dawn, Brock, and Barry compete in the [[Festival Battle Challenge]] for the right to challenge Barry's father, [[Palmer]]. Ash wins the tournament but loses against Palmer. ([[DP141]]) * At the [[Johto Festival]], Dawn receives a [[Pokémon Egg]] from {{an|Lyra}} which later hatches into a {{p|Cyndaquil}}. ([[DP143]]) * [[Jupiter]] and Charon complete the [[Red Chain]] project. In the meantime, Saturn finds the entrance to the Spear Pillar. ([[DP150]]) * Pokémon Hunter J captures the [[lake guardians]] for Team Galactic. However, her ship is destroyed by a {{m|Future Sight}} attack from {{p|Mesprit}} and {{p|Uxie}}. ([[DP151]]) * Cyrus summons {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} on the Spear Pillar. After Mesprit, {{p|Azelf}} and Uxie are rescued, he disappears through a portal. ([[DP152]]) * Ash and his friends watch a Pokémon Contest where Zoey earns her fifth and final Ribbon for the [[Grand Festival]]. They also meet Candice again. ([[DP155]]) * Paul is interviewed on TV where he is shown to have earned his eighth [[Badge]] to qualify for the [[Sinnoh League]]. ([[DP155]]) * Ash and his friends meet a wild {{AP|Gible}} who wants to learn {{m|Draco Meteor}}. language Galactic Battles home video releases (Region 4)}} ==Trivia== * This is the last season of {{aniseries|PTS}} to air in {{pmin|Israel}} before the release of {{aniseries|XY}}, about six years later; in {{pmin|Romania}} before the release of {{aniseries|SM}}, about eight years later; and in {{pmin|Hungary}} before the release of {{aniseries|JN}}, about ten years later. * This is the last
